name: codex-review
description: Drive one Codex review round on a GitHub PR — request, wait until settled, read the head commit's findings, and track resolution markers.

interface.shortDescription: Request a Codex PR review and know when it has actually finished.
interface.longDescription: Wraps codex-wait.sh: posts the @codex review trigger, waits for the settle window, reads only reviews covering the head commit, and reports findings with staleness and resolution counts so rounds converge.
